headline: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO, CFO Colette Kress named interim
body: Jensen Huang resigned as CEO, president, and board member of Nvidia effective immediately, according to a statement on November 12. Colette Kress is taking over as interim CEO while the board searches for a permanent successor, and Harvey C. Jones will serve as the first independent board chair. The Decoder says Nvidia has shed roughly $1.4 trillion in market value since a New York Times report on October 29.
note: Nvidia now has an interim CEO and a board search under way, so the permanent choice is the open question for anyone tracking AI infrastructure.

evidence.text: Jensen Huang resigned as CEO, president, and board member of Nvidia effective immediately, according to a statement on November 12, 2026.
Since a New York Times report on October 29 about possible ties to Chinese intelligence, Nvidia has shed roughly $1.4 trillion in market value.
CFO Colette Kress is taking over on an interim basis while the board searches for a permanent successor.
Harvey C. Jones will serve as the first independent board chair and stressed that business operations continue without disruption.
Nvidia confirmed in an SEC filing on Thursday that the board accepted Huang’s resignation on Wednesday.
